title: SDK Surface Release — modular samples, gated docs, and partner pilot plan
creator: Priya Narang
description:
Goal: Coordinate a staged SDK + API surface release that includes function-calling, structured output, and streaming support, with a modular sample kit and a small set of partner pilot integrations.

Scope:
- Finalize SDK surface changes (Python/Node/Go) for function calling and structured streaming output.
- Publish a modular sample kit: canonical examples for chat+function-calling, structured JSON output, streaming client usage, and migration snippets (v1 -> v2). Samples must be small, runnable, and localized to region-specific endpoints.
- Gate docs: doc pages must pass tech review and security checklist before public release. Provide a private beta docs bundle for partners.
- Run 3 partner pilots (two enterprise, one startup) to validate auth flows, streaming reliability, and function-calling semantics.

Success metrics:
- SDK adoption: 50 unique orgs using new endpoints within 30 days of GA.
- Sample kit: 90% of partner support requests answered by sample code in PR window.
- Docs quality: <5 doc bugs reported in first two weeks.
- Performance: no regression >5% on median latency for hosted SDK calls compared to baseline.

Rollout plan:
1) Internal alpha: SDK + samples + docs (engineering + design sign-off) — target 2025-03-20.
2) Partner pilot (private docs, invitation only) — target 2025-03-27.
3) Staged public GA: opt-in beta for all customers, then full GA (feature-flagged) — target 2025-04-01.

Cross-team responsibilities:
- Product (owner): coordinate timelines, partner outreach, release notes, and success tracking.
- Engineering: implement API surface parity, SDK docs, performance regression tests, and feature flags (ENG-28912).
- Design: UX for streaming SDK samples, code snippets, and sample README templates (DES-3122).
- Developer Experience: package sample kit, publish SDK releases, update npm/pypi/go modules, and prepare migration guides.
- Security/Compliance: complete security review and KMS/credential guidance for partner pilots.
- Marketing & GTM: prepare partner comms, release notes, changelog, and localized sample snippets.

Artifacts & links:
- Design spec: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DES/SDK+Streaming+UX
- Implementation PR (SDK): https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/1423
- Sample kit repo (WIP): https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/tree/sdk-surface-2025
- Partner pilot roster (internal drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1SdkPilotRoster
- Telemetry dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/sdk-release-2025

Open questions / risks:
- Do we need a separate regionalized sample bundle for EU/APAC customers due to data residency? (action: PM to confirm with legal by 2025-03-14)
- Streaming semantics edge cases with function-calling + partial results: require design clarifications and integration tests.
- Security review windows may push GA if HSM/KMS guidance needs work.

Release notes bullets (draft):
- New: Function-calling first-class SDK support with typed call helpers.
- New: Structured output templates and schema validation helpers.
- New: Streaming client examples (Python/Node) and server-side streaming guidance.
- Note: Migration snippets included for v1 users; feature-flag rollout to avoid breaking changes.
